issues.issue: Whether the RAD unreasonably refused to admit three new affidavits from the applicant's relatives.
issues.applicant_position: Affidavits post-date the RPD decision and respond to its credibility concerns, so they should be admitted.
issues.result_text: RAD reasonably excluded the affidavits; they could have been submitted earlier with due diligence.

issues.issue: Whether the RAD unreasonably confirmed the RPD's finding that the applicant was not credible on central allegations.
issues.applicant_position: Credibility findings rest on minor inconsistencies and were unreasonable.
issues.result_text: It was reasonably open to the RAD to find the applicant not credible and confirm the RPD.

issues.issue: Whether the RAD applied the presumption of truthfulness and explained why it was rebutted.
issues.applicant_position: RAD failed to apply the presumption of credibility and made no explicit finding that it was rebutted.
issues.result_text: RAD explicitly addressed the presumption argument and reasonably found it rebutted by inconsistencies and omissions.
